turns.text: Which product will run out before its supplier can deliver more?

{"sql": "SELECT p.sku, p.name, p.supplier, p.on_hand, p.daily_demand, 
       CASE WHEN p.daily_demand>0 THEN p.on_hand*1.0/p.daily_demand ELSE NULL END AS days_of_stock,
       s.lead_time_days, s.as_of
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN supplier_leadtimes s ON p.sku = s.sku
ORDER BY days_of_stock ASC"}
